_doc: Dark-mode map for Tailwind colour utilities. Edit this file, then: node scripts/gen-theme-tw.js (see the header of that script). map: token -> dark value (string, or {value, also, tags}); compounds / descendants: same-element and in-element rules; allow: token -> why it is left alone.

primary button became lime: lime text would vanish

opacityFloor.floorWhy: ink #DAE2FD needs >=0.555 over --sand (#222A3D, the worst page surface), >=0.595 over --line; 0.6 gives 5.74 / 5.43 / 4.98 on cream / card / sand and 4.53 on --line. Equals the existing opacity-60 tier, so the dark hierarchy collapses 30..55 into 60.

variantAllow.hover:opacity-100: interactive fade-in on hover (base tier is opacity-70, which already passes)
variantAllow.hover:opacity-90: hover dim of an already fully opaque button
variantAllow.disabled:opacity-25: disabled control: inactive components are exempt from contrast (WCAG 1.4.3)
variantAllow.disabled:opacity-30: disabled control: inactive components are exempt from contrast
variantAllow.disabled:opacity-40: disabled control: inactive components are exempt from contrast

classification.text-only: floor applies: opacity-30/40/45/50/55 on spans/divs/p/li/td/tr/button text (the vast majority)
classification.decorative: exempt: svg, img, canvas, i (dots), .animate-pulse, opacity-[0.14|0.16|0.18] glows/watermark
classification.disabled: exempt: :disabled / [aria-disabled=true] / a conditional 'disabled' attribute branch (the 2 mixed-looking buttons above; the past calendar days: btn.disabled + opacity-30, .cal-day:disabled{opacity:.28}); disabled:opacity-* variants
classification.interactive-fade: exempt: hover:opacity-100 / hover:opacity-90 (state variants, never raised)
classification.mixed: text element that also paints its own fill/border. Exactly ONE is floored: the 'No poster' placeholder div (index.html #posterPreview, bg-[#F1E9DF] opacity-50). Two others only LOOK mixed but are <button disabled> and therefore EXEMPT via :disabled: index.html ~7017 (og link picker, 'different time from your game', bg-[#F7F1EA] opacity-55) and store.html ~595 (out-of-stock product, bg-[#F1E9DF] opacity-50). With a --sand fill the group contrast of the floored one at 0.6 is 4.98 over cream/card (>=4.5). tests/theme-tw-opacity.test.js derives these counts from the markup.
classification.inline-style: tournament standings td style=opacity:0.5 and the % span style=opacity:0.4 are covered by [style*=] attribute rules; index loading text opacity:0.6 already passes; page <style> blocks (.cal-day:disabled, pulse keyframes) and the winner-PDF print window are exempt

opacityFloor.inlineNote: [style*="opacity:0.5"] also lifts opacity:0.55 / 0.50 and [style*="opacity:0.4"] also lifts opacity:0.45 / 0.40 (substring match; intentional, both are below the floor). The generator rejects every inline form the selectors cannot match (space after the colon, no leading zero, percentages) and any fill-/stroke-/stop-/flood-opacity below the floor, and fails on a floored tier combined with a hover:/focus:/active:/group-hover: opacity variant on one element (the !important floor would silently kill the variant).

notes.hover:text-[#201C19]: maps to on-lime and is only safe on an element whose hover fill is lime (hover:bg-[#D6FF5F]); tests/theme-tw-generator.test.js asserts every occurrence has one (index.html only today).
notes.divide-[#F5EDE4]: the dark divide rule (0,5,0)!important recolours the border of every child it matches; tests/theme-tw-generator.test.js asserts no divide child carries its own border-[hex].
